Some vocations have special places that only they can enter, and druids are no exception. Cross the {wiki:Magic Forcefield} in the Plains of Havoc to reach the {wiki:Isle of the Mists} and collect 2 {item:Small Emerald|Small Emeralds} and a {item:Book} from the box and the drawer on the ground floor.
